paragraphs: R. Yiva the Elder; later written with two yods. Rav's student. Rav Beruna and Rav Chananel sat at a meal, with R. Yiva the Elder attending them. He told them, “Thus Rav said”—Pesachim 103b, beginning; Chullin 86b. He asked Rav Nachman, saying, “Answer me, my master”—Bava Kamma 49b. The Zohar frequently brings R. Yeiva the Elder, “and the ...” [והת׳, unresolved]. See Idra, Haazinu, in the aggadah of Rav Yeiva the Elder.
